answer: Gate payouts behind lineage escrow: a new identity's earnings stay locked until it produces coherent, original work across several consecutive epochs, each answer extending its own previous ones the way strata of shale build on older rock. Sybils are cheap to mint but expensive to mature — abandoned identities forfeit their escrow — so a farm of thousands must sustain real work everywhere at once, and only a proven lineage earns the sable mark that releases payment, while karst-hollow fresh accounts earn nothing.
